description: List a Reddit user's public achievements, the trophies shown on their reddit.com/user/<name>/achievements page. Returns each achievement's name, description, granted timestamp and icons, plus a count. An account with none returns an empty list rather than an error, so a zero count is a real answer. Use to gauge account age and standing (One-Year Club, Verified Email) or to check a moderator's history. Example: name='spez'.

name.description: Reddit username WITHOUT the u/ prefix (e.g. 'spez'). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_user_achievements
